pages.title: Tool Bench
pages.text: When equipment reaches its maximum level, use it on a Tool Bench with the material shown by the bench. The item keeps its identity while moving to its next material tier.

pages.title: Repair Bench
pages.text: Use damaged equipment on a Repair Bench with a matching repair material or Scrap. Excess repair can become temporary over-repair instead of being wasted. Nearby containers can supply materials to either bench.
